title: Encrypted backup and fresh-store restore
description: Spec §10. scrypt-derived passphrase key, authenticated KDF header, bounded parameters, restore only into an empty store with a fresh vault key, bindings cleared and grants/approvals inactive.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T20: restore works with only the backup and passphrase; wrong passphrase, corruption, hostile KDF parameters and oversized backups fail safely
T21: restore uses a fresh key and leaves bindings absent and grants/approvals inactive pending review

plan: 2. Domain: the backup container (v1: scrypt N=131072, r=8, p=1, 32-byte salt, 32-byte key, AES-256-GCM with a fresh nonce; format and KDF parameters authenticated) with bounded sizes and parameters refused before any allocation; unit tests.

3. Application: runBackup and runRestore over a passphrase port and a backup-file port. Restore refuses any non-empty destination, generates a fresh vault key and id, preserves project records, and clears local bindings (approvals and grants do not exist in the state model yet; the obligation is recorded for WCLI-9/WCLI-12).

4. Adapters: hidden-input terminal passphrase reader (echo suppressed via raw mode, bounded, confirmation on create) and the backup file (created mode 0600 with O_EXCL and no overwrite, read bounded).
5. CLI and contract: ward backup --output <path>, ward restore --input <path>, manifest entries, error catalog additions, contract tests.

6. Tests: T20 six ways (round-trip with only the backup and passphrase; wrong passphrase; corruption; hostile KDF parameters; oversized backup; missing terminal) and T21 (fresh key and id, bindings absent), each measured against the pre-change state where applicable.
7. ADR 0006 recording the container format and the restore authority rules; docs sync and lore check --strict exit 0.
8. bun run check green, independent review dispatched over the diff, findings fixed, criteria checked on the branch, PR merged, dev promoted to main.
